source: CBK 'Next MPC Meeting' notice of 9 November 2026: the Monetary Policy Committee will meet on Wednesday 9 December 2026.
note: Set from CBK's own notice page (dated 9 November 2026), found by search because centralbank.go.ke cannot be fetched from a session, and corroborated by a second independently phrased search and a press report of the same notice. The 7 October 2026 press release had said only 'December 2026'. The Central Bank Rate is 8.75 percent, held on 7 October.
